errors.tooFewFaces: Cannot create surfaces: too few triangles ({{count, count}}, at least {{min, count}}).
errors.cageFailed: Cannot create auto surfaces: the scan gives no closed control cage. Repair the scan (fill holes, remove small parts) and try again.
errors.shapeInvalid: Cannot create auto surfaces: the surfaces do not form a valid body. Choose more smoothing or another detail level.
errors.notAutoSurface: The element is not an auto surface.
errors.netFailed: The scan gives no clean quad net. Repair the scan (fill holes, remove small parts) or choose another net density.
errors.netInvalid: The freeform net is damaged: its quads do not form one consistently oriented surface. Undo the last change.
errors.netShapeInvalid: The net gives no valid CAD faces (folded or crossing quads). Undo the last change or snap the net to the scan.
errors.notFreeformNet: The element is not a freeform net.

issues.openSurface: The scan is open. The result is a surface, not a body. Fill the holes first to get a body.
issues.partsIgnored: Only the largest part was processed; {{count, count}} other parts were left out.
issues.openNet: The net has open borders. The result is a surface, not a body; it does not count as a body for export and booleans.

progress.fitting: Fitting control cage to the scan
